title: Static vs. Dynamic Typing and Type Safety
instructions: Answer from the lesson. For short-answer and practical items, equivalent technically correct wording/code earns credit.

questions.prompt: Are Python type annotations generally enforced by the runtime automatically?

options.text: No; external/static tools can analyze them

questions.explanation: Annotations support tooling but ordinary Python does not generally enforce them at runtime.

questions.prompt: Which language adds compile-time type checking on top of JavaScript syntax?
questions.explanation: TypeScript checks types and emits JavaScript.

questions.prompt: What is one benefit and one limitation of static type checking?
questions.expected_answer: Balanced answer recognizes both value and limits.

questions.prompt: An API returns JSON with `age: "17"` but your type says age is a number. What should the program do?
questions.expected_answer: External input needs runtime schema/domain checks.

questions.prompt: Why is `name: string` not valid ordinary JavaScript parameter syntax?
questions.expected_answer: JavaScript can use runtime checks or JSDoc/tooling, but TypeScript syntax requires TypeScript processing.
